_meta.name: FAC probe batch
_meta.author: agent-authored (Claude), during the 1.2.3 build session
_meta.standing: DEVELOPMENT VERIFICATION SET. Same standing as address_verify_samples.json: fine to build against, NEVER quotable. It is committed on purpose -- burned and blind sets are hidden because visibility destroys them; a verification set is the opposite, visibility is its purpose.
_meta.not_a_measurement: This batch produces no recall figure. The blind measurement of the FAC mapping is batch v4, reviewer-authored, unseen by this session before it runs.
_meta.purpose: Evidence for promoting spaCy's FAC label to ADDRESS. The class the mapping exists for is the UNNUMBERED street / facility reference ('the warehouse on Willis Street'), which the street_address recognizer does not cover -- it requires a leading number, and for ambiguous street types a trailing comma-locality. Numbered forms are included to prove the existing path does not regress.
_meta.control_provenance: Controls are NOT sourced from the burned corpora (samples.json, holdout_samples.json, eval_samples_v2.json, holdout_v3.json), which stayed closed for this task. Sources are recorded per line in the `provenance` field: trap-list = HANDOVER.md's named trap class; glossary = glossary.txt; test-file = test_address.py / test_jargon.py; authored = written fresh for this batch. No control claims corpus-observed provenance.
_meta.reading_the_pii_field: For POSITIVE lines, pii carries the value expected to redact once FAC -> ADDRESS ships. For CONTROL lines, pii is EMPTY -- a control asserts that nothing redacts. The `note` and `provenance` fields are metadata and are NEVER transmitted to the service; the harness sends `text` only.
_meta.validation: Every line's actual behaviour is recorded in fac_probe_validation.md, measured inside ghcr.io/terusin71/pii-scrubber:1.2.2 (sha256:958bd5c3cd7051bd86df5905d072d5342ffd7268d7ae482dae7546f4b3ff3fa6), presidio-analyzer 2.2.357, spacy 3.8.3, en_core_web_sm 3.8.0.
